description: 기상청 항공기상청_공항기상관측장비 데이터 [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기상청 항공기상청. 공항기상관측시스템(AMOS, Aerodrome Meteorological Observation System)은 활주로에 설치된 다양한 기상관측 장비를 통해 기온, 기압, 풍향·풍속,. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기상청 항공기상청. Its tags are 공항, 활주로, 기상실황, AMOS, 공항기상관측시스템. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-10-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
